    """Rows whose most common cell is the given line color."""

    """Columns whose most common cell is the given line color."""
    return [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if Counter(r[j] for r in grid).most_common(1)[0][0] == line]

def intersection_values(grid, lrows, lcols, line):
    """Map (row, col) -> value for every line/lattice intersection not of the line color."""
    return {(i, j): grid[i][j] for i in lrows for j in lcols if grid[i][j] != line}

def lattice_gap_map(srows, scols, vals, fill=9):
    """Draw each special value's maximal rectangle (in lattice lines) into the grid of gaps
    between consecutive special rows and columns; other gaps get the fill color."""
    H, W = len(srows) - 1, len(scols) - 1
    out = [[fill] * W for _ in range(H)]
    pts = defaultdict(list)
    for (i, j), v in vals.items():
